The '''''Ruby & Sapphire'' arc''' (Japanese: '''ルビー・サファイア編''' ''Ruby & Sapphire arc''), also referred to as '''''The Fourth Chapter''''' (Japanese: '''第四章''' ''The Fourth Chapter''), is the fourth story arc of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, consisting of eight volumes. It is the second longest completed arc of the series, behind the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}. It began serialization in December 2002, and ended in August 2006.

This arc features the {{pkmn|journey}}s of {{adv|Ruby}} and {{adv|Sapphire}} who are trying to conquer all the [[Pokémon Contest]]s and [[Gym]]s in [[Hoenn]] respectively within the span of 80 days. However, this gets interrupted by two new [[Villainous team|evil organizations]], the land-loving [[Team Magma]] and the sea-loving [[Team Aqua]], whose plans regarding the {{adv|super-ancient Pokémon}} of Hoenn threaten to plunge the entire region into a state of untold devastation. Sapphire and Ruby have to worry about something else, too: their feelings for each other.

===Omnibus releases===
{{main|List of Pokémon Adventures omnibus volumes}}
The ''Ruby & Sapphire'' arc was originally planned for a 2011 release as part of [[Shogakukan]]'s "My First Wide" series of omnibus volumes. The ''Ruby & Sapphire'' arc was chosen due to its high popularity in Japan. A total of three volumes were planned. After the first volume was released, the series was discontinued due to the {{wp|2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami}}.

In 2014, another omnibus release was announced for the arc in commemoration of the release of [[Pokémon Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire]]. The volumes were released under Shogakukan's "My First Series" brand, which are bargain-priced volumes sold only in Japanese convenience stores. A total of four volumes were released, beginning with [[Pocket Monsters Special Ruby Sapphire volume 1|first volume]] on October 24, 2014.

An English language omnibus release was announced by [[Shogakukan Asia]] in early 2015 under the title "Pokémon Adventures: Ruby & Sapphire". This release consists of four total volumes, [[Pokémon Adventures Ruby & Sapphire volume 1|the first]] of which was released in January.

A three-volume omnibus release of the ''Ruby & Sapphire'' arc has also begun in {{pmin|France}}, starting from December 2014.

==Important events==
{{spoilers}}
{{main|Timeline of events in Pokémon Adventures#Ruby & Sapphire arc|Timeline of events in the Ruby & Sapphire arc of Pokémon Adventures}}
* About two years have passed since the end of the {{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}.
* {{adv|Ruby}} moves from [[Johto]] to [[Hoenn]] and runs away from home.
* Ruby meets {{adv|Sapphire}} and they receive their [[first partner Pokémon]]. After this they arrange a [[Timeline of Ruby and Sapphire's 80-day challenge|bet]].
* {{adv|Norman}} grants Ruby's wish and lets him compete in [[Pokémon Contest]]s.
* [[Team Aqua]] stops the volcanic activity at [[Mt. Chimney]].
* [[Team Magma]] blows the [[Rusturf Tunnel]] up.
* The two [[villainous team]]s decide to cooperate and travel to [[Seafloor Cavern]] together.
* {{p|Kyogre}} and {{p|Groudon}} are awakened and start destroying the [[region]].
* Norman and {{adv|Wally}} awaken {{p|Rayquaza}}.
* Ruby and Sapphire stop [[Maxie]] and [[Archie]].
* Ruby and Sapphire achieve their goals.
* {{adv|Giovanni}} finds the Red and Blue Orbs that have been transformed into gems.

==Trivia==
*This is the first completed arc to not include former main characters, although {{adv|Red}} has several cameos. 
*Ruby and Sapphire's bet was likely based on the novel ''{{wp|Around the World in Eighty Days}}'', by {{wp|Jules Verne}}, in which a man takes a wager to circumnavigate the globe in a mere 80 days.
*When this arc was being published in the magazines later, it was known as the Ruby, Sapphire & Emerald arc (Japanese: '''ルビー ・ サファイア ・ エメラルド編''' ''Ruby, Sapphire & Emerald chapter'').
